title: A playtest walk leaves its pictures in the repo instead of the scratch folder
goal: One of the scripted walks writes its screenshots into the project folder rather than a temporary one, so after it runs there are several megabytes of pictures sitting in the working copy that nobody asked for and that could get committed by accident. It should put them where every other walk puts them.
notes:
Scripts/playtest/panel-says-less-walk.json is the only walk with no "out" key, so the harness defaults to `out` beside the script, which is inside the repo. Every other walk names an absolute /tmp/photonz-playtest/<name> path.

REPRODUCTION, run on 2026-09-14:

  $ rm -rf Scripts/playtest/out
  $ Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/panel-says-less-walk.json --no-build
  ...
  panel-says-less-arrange-reference-sc.png
  panel-says-less-arrange-reference.png
  panel-says-less-three-picked-sc.png
  panel-says-less-three-picked.png
  panel-three-picked.json
  ==> Probe quit.
  $ git status --short | grep playtest
  ?? Scripts/playtest/out/
  $ du -sh Scripts/playtest/out
  2.6M

Fix is one line: give the walk an "out" of /tmp/photonz-playtest/panel-says-less like its neighbours. Worth also checking whether the harness should refuse a default that lands inside the repo at all, since the next walk written without an "out" repeats this.
acceptance: Running the walk leaves nothing new inside the repository folder
The walk still passes and its pictures still land somewhere a person can look at them
No other walk has the same problem

log.note: Still happening on 2026-09-15: Scripts/playtest/out/ was sitting untracked at the top of git status at the start of an unrelated study task (done.json, log.json, and four panel-says-less PNGs including two -sc.png captures). It is not in .gitignore either, so a 'git add -A' sweeps it into the commit. That nearly happened here and was caught by reading the staged list. Worth covering both halves: put the pictures in the scratch folder, and ignore the path so a stray run cannot be committed by accident.

Reproduced before fixing: a throwaway walk with no "out" in Scripts/playtest resolved out to /Users/dzearing/git/photonz/Scripts/playtest/out and left done.json and log.json there. The specific walk named in the task (panel-says-less) had already picked up an explicit out in passing in commit eb474448 on 2026-09-14, so the remaining bug was the default itself, which is the half that would catch the next walk written.

Adversarial review before building: the one-line fix the task suggested was already in, so building it would have been a no-op that closed the task with the trap intact. The durable fix is the default itself. Considered also refusing a relative "out" that lands in the repo and decided against it: a relative out is written into the file by hand, visible at review, and is documented as how a script folder travels with its renders, whereas the default is what a walk falls into by saying nothing. The folder-wide test covers the deliberate case anyway.
No audit written: this is loop plumbing, not something the user can try in the app, so there is nothing for them to playtest or react to.

left rough: the harness still ALLOWS a relative "out" pointing inside the repo at run time; only the test catches it, so a walk run from a branch before its test lands could still litter. Did not clear the follow-up bar: no walk does this, nobody would notice, and the .gitignore net plus the test cover it. Noting here so a later pass in this area finds it.

left rough: acceptance item 2 ("the walk still passes") could not be checked. The Mac's screen was locked for the entire task, so every walk reported status locked and neither passed nor failed. Asked for a sweep so the first unlocked run confirms it. Not filed as a task: it is the documented locked-screen behaviour working correctly, not a defect.

A walk that names no output folder now writes to /tmp/photonz-playtest/<its name> instead of beside its own script inside the repo (Sources/PhotonzCore/PlaytestScript.swift, matched in Scripts/playtest.sh). New PlaytestWalkOutputFolderTests reads all 456 walks and fails if any resolves inside the repository; proven by pointing one back at 'out' and watching it fail. Reproduced the bug first, confirmed the fix by rerunning the same walk into /tmp with the launcher finding done.json there, full suite green at 7192 tests. The screen was locked all task so no walk could be run to a pass; a sweep is requested. Commit 5130e1d8, pushed.
